pr.title: Improve generating, phase 1: faster ratings (P6) with identical puzzles, the history policy, and the gen-v4 frozen-round harness

v12.body:
## What's Changed
* Re-create puzzles from a printout: puzzle codes, QR on the print sheet, Share and Import by @tdat00 in https://github.com/tdat00/pentomino/pull/7
* Mobile UI/UX for the Player and the Generator: icon header, one-column steps, fixed pieces bar, one puzzle at a time by @tdat00 in https://github.com/tdat00/pentomino/pull/8
* Player: a placed piece is never turned in place; rotate and flip send it to the tray by @tdat00 in https://github.com/tdat00/pentomino/pull/9


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tdat00/pentomino/compare/v1.1...v1.2
